title: NATS SUB acknowledgment must be awaited before treating a watch subscription as established
answers: why does natsNotifier retry subscribing even though Subscribe succeeded
local subscribe success but no events delivered on NATS
how does the notifier know a NATS subscription is really live
body: nats.go can accept a SUB call locally and return success even while the client is disconnected from the server, so a successful Subscribe() call alone does not prove the server has established interest. natsNotifier.trySubscribe (pkg/storage/unified/resource/notifier_nats.go) must call sub.WaitReady(ctx) (backed by conn.FlushWithContext in pkg/infra/nats/subscriber.go's readySubscription) after Subscribe and before calling opts.captured(nil)/returning true. If WaitReady fails, the subscription must be Unsubscribe()'d and the caller must retry rather than proceeding as if capture is live.
applies: pkg/storage/unified/resource/notifier_nats.go trySubscribe and any future snapshot-to-live handoff logic that depends on capture readiness
